verdict.rationale: No evidence shows Bitbucket Cloud letting customers pick a storage region. The only indirect support is that a self-managed Bitbucket Server/Data Center deployment exists (referenced by the migration app and Data Center licensing), which would let an organization keep data where it hosts it. GDPR compliance and encryption at rest are cited, but they are not residency controls. Missing for 10: documented Cloud data residency/region selection, list of available regions, scope of which data is pinned, first-party residency docs, and independent corroboration.
